text: Going to the Wild Area is a snap if you use\nthe Flying Taxis!

If you want to heal up your Pokémon, there’s
nothing like setting up your camp and cooking
them a good meal. Here, you can add this Berry
to the pot!

If you ever come across a tent, check it out to
join the camp of whoever set it up.\c
If you’d like, you’re welcome to visit my camp
too—it’s this one right here!

If your precious Pokémon get injured, don’t
forget to heal them up with a Potion!\c
And you need Antidotes to fix up poison.\c
Just remember to stock up on items, and you
won’t have to visit Pokémon Centers so often!
